name: clippy boundary steering
command: cd /home/factory/home/projects/work-checkout && export TMPDIR=/tmp RUSTUP_HOME=$HOME/.rustup CARGO_HOME=$HOME/.cargo; (cd core && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings > /tmp/clippy.log 2>&1; echo exit=$? >> /tmp/clippy.log); scripts/check-steering.sh . > /tmp/steer.log 2>&1; echo exit=$? >> /tmp/steer.log; scripts/check-core-boundary.sh > /tmp/boundary.log 2>&1; echo exit=$? >> /tmp/boundary.log
